name: Yumesaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yumesaki town emblem in green: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Yumesaki in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27. The municipal emblem was adopted in December 1962.

features.role: Yumesaki town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
